image_description: A grand, ornate pipe organ situated in a church or cathedral setting. The instrument features multiple towers of vertical metal pipes of varying heights, arranged symmetrically with elaborate gilded wood carvings and decorative moldings. A wooden console with keyboards is visible at the base, though the pedalboard is obscured by shadow and angle. The lighting is warm, highlighting the gold leaf details against the darker wood and metal pipes.
